The '''Guuko system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Weneen sector/Legends|Weneen sector]], a part of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions known as the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]].<ref name="New Territories" /> It was the origin point of the group known as [[Guukosi]] as well as the [[Guuko Pure Light party]].<ref name="501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Guukosi]] and the [[Guuko Pure Light party]]|system=Guuko [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Guuko system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square N-6.<ref name="EAOC" />
